source.text: בהנחל עליון גוים בהפרידו בני אדם יצב גבלת עמים למספר בני אלוהים׃
source.composition: Unpointed WLC base with only the final referent replaced; not a complete 4Q37 transcription.
source.opening_choice: Retain בהנחל by explicit base-spelling policy; בהנחי[ל] is the published 4Q37 alternative, not judged historically later.
source.vocalization_policy: Interpret unchanged units according to the base; changed phrase understood as sons of God; no ancient vowel points recovered.

judgment.confidence: Moderate for the divine referent; lower for exact earliest form; no confidence increase over the earlier working preference.
judgment.basis: Direct published Hebrew plus allocation/portion context and qualified Greek divine-referent support.
judgment.strongest_countercase: MT/SP directly attest Israel and permit a coherent retrospective Israel-number interpretation; excerpt adaptation of 4Q37 remains possible but not locally demonstrated.
judgment.el_alternative: Exact בני אל in Deuteronomy remains conjectural in the consulted OHB sample; Tov reports a potentially relevant 1QHa allusion, not independently collated here.
judgment.fouad848_limit: Sons noun only; God/Israel complement lost. Supersedes complete-phrase support in the old pilot matrix.
judgment.reported_106_correction: Sons of Israel with edition qualifications; modern adjacent apparatus and actual correction image unconsulted.
judgment.chronology_removed: Same provisional preference; age is not the deciding premise.
judgment.armenian_and_later_latin_removed: Same provisional preference; not dependent on multiplying later quotations.
judgment.greek_divine_support_removed: Preference weakens; one fragmentary Hebrew excerpt alone does not settle priority over MT/SP.
judgment.context_removed: Attestation alone does not decide direction of change.

consultation.qdr_scope: Section 12, rows 12-14 and displayed MT/SP parallels; published text, not new image reading.
consultation.qdr_credit: Qumran-Digital, DFG project 465277421, CC BY-SA 4.0; no full corpus import.
consultation.tov_limit: Argument and note 6 consulted; no acceptance of complete-phrase Greek table over finer edition controls or of observed theological motive. Hymn allusion reported only.

gates.native_image_and_djd_material: uncompleted; no fresh physical claim; limits explicit provisional published-source judgment
gates.independent_assessment: Report-aware source assessment supports provisional proposal; not blind and not full-record approval.
